House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". "Fredagstaco" is a widespread Friday-evening custom in Norway; the story only mentions it in passing. A Norwegian reviewer should confirm how natural it sounds.

sentences.text: På fredag er det fredagskveld. Alle er trøtte etter uka.
sentences.english: On Friday it is Friday evening. Everyone is tired after the week.

sentences.text: Anna og Lars har ofte taco på fredag. Det er mat som alle liker.
sentences.english: Anna and Lars often have tacos on Friday. It is food that everyone likes.

sentences.text: I dag kommer Marta og Nils også. De skal spise hos Anna og Lars.
sentences.english: Today Marta and Nils are coming too. They will eat at Anna and Lars's.

sentences.text: Sam hjelper Anna med maten. Han lager taco for første gang.
sentences.english: Sam helps Anna with the food. He makes tacos for the first time.

sentences.text: Du lager bra mat, Sam!
sentences.english: You make good food, Sam!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Takk! Jeg liker taco. Det er god mat, og det er lett å lage.
sentences.english: Thanks! I like tacos. It is good food, and it is easy to make.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Alle sitter ved bordet og spiser.
sentences.english: Everyone sits at the table and eats.

sentences.text: Jeg vil ha mer taco!
sentences.english: I want more tacos!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Du har spist mye, Nils. Nå er du mett.
sentences.english: You have eaten a lot, Nils. Now you are full.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Etter maten sitter de i sofaen. De skal se en film.
sentences.english: After the meal they sit on the sofa. They are going to watch a film.

sentences.text: Hvilken film vil dere se?
sentences.english: Which film do you want to watch?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg vil se en film om fjell og fjorder!
sentences.english: I want to watch a film about mountains and fjords!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Det er en bra film. Vi har vært i fjellet.
sentences.english: That is a good film. We have been in the mountains.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Etter filmen vil Nils spille. Han liker å spille.
sentences.english: After the film Nils wants to play. He likes to play.

sentences.text: Kan vi spille, Sam?
sentences.english: Can we play, Sam?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne! Vi spiller, og så sover du.
sentences.english: Yes, gladly! We play, and then you sleep.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Marta sitter i sofaen. Hun er glad, og hun er trøtt.
sentences.english: Marta sits on the sofa. She is happy, and she is tired.

sentences.text: Fredag er en bra dag. Vi spiser, vi snakker, og vi er glade.
sentences.english: Friday is a good day. We eat, we talk, and we are happy.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nils sier: «Jeg vil ha is og pølse, som på sytten mai!» Han tenker på flagg og tog og bunad.
sentences.english: Nils says: "I want ice cream and sausage, like on the seventeenth of May!" He thinks of flags and parades and bunads.

sentences.text: Jeg synes at film er bra. Er du enig, Nils?
sentences.english: I think film is good. Do you agree, Nils?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Kanskje. Jeg liker taco mer enn film.
sentences.english: Maybe. I like tacos more than film.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Nå er det høst. Etter høsten kommer vinteren, og så kommer våren og sommeren.
sentences.english: Now it is autumn. After the autumn comes the winter, and then come the spring and the summer.

sentences.text: Vi gikk til kirka på søndag, og vi spiste middag hos Marta. Det var bra.
sentences.english: We went to church on Sunday, and we had dinner at Marta's. It was good.
